title: Identify European Soil copied halfwords
changes: Extend the opt-in test-only interpreter capture to record selected byte-copy reader and caller contexts.
Authenticate a four-halfword copied source with a separately owned pointer.
validation: Wine capture e283-soil-14d6d8-reader-wine-kg1o5ej2 identifies all eight source bytes at the original byte-load instruction and its return context; caller disassembly 84wwsn66 and static plan _nouuxnz verify the eight-byte copy and subsequent halfword indexing.
limitations: No guest index bound, state equivalence, complete callers, other scenes or runtime ownership is inferred.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain open; no performance comparison was performed.
